title: DS-Lighting: Making Agent Harnesses Explicit for Data-Science Automation
abstract: arXiv:2608.28590v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise for automating data-science workflows, yet their end-to-end performance depends critically on the agent harness that represents tasks, manages execution state, constrains output artifacts, and provides evaluation feedback. Existing data-science agents often leave this harness implicit, making results difficult to reproduce, compare, and attribute across heterogeneous tasks. We introduce DS-Lighting, a unified harness toolkit that makes harness design explicit for data-science automation. DS-Lighting decomposes the harness into four reusable layers: data, workflow, execution, and evaluation, and represents diverse agents as executable operator programs that support both predefined pipelines and adaptive search. We further integrate multiple open-source data-science benchmarks into an MLE-Bench-style task format, enabling controlled comparison under a shared task interface, sandboxed run

translated_title: DS-Lighting：让智能体框架在数据科学自动化中显式化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在自动化数据科学工作流方面已展现出潜力，但其端到端性能在很大程度上取决于智能体框架（agent harness），该框架负责表示任务、管理执行状态、约束输出产物并提供评估反馈。现有的数据科学智能体往往将这一框架隐式化，导致结果在不同异构任务之间难以复现、比较和归因。我们提出了 DS-Lighting，一个统一的框架工具包，使数据科学自动化的框架设计显式化。DS-Lighting 将框架分解为四个可复用的层次：数据、工作流、执行和评估，并将各类智能体表示为可执行的算子程序，同时支持预定义流水线和自适应搜索。我们进一步将多个开源数据科学基准整合为 MLE-Bench 风格的任务格式，从而在共享任务接口和沙箱化运行环境下实现受控比较……
tldr: 提出了 DS-Lighting，一个将智能体框架显式分解为数据、工作流、执行和评估四个可复用层次的统一工具包，从而提升数据科学自动化中 LLM 智能体结果的可复现性与可比性。
en_tdlr: DS-Lighting is a unified agent harness toolkit that makes harness design explicit by decomposing it into four reusable layers (data, workflow, execution, evaluation), improving reproducibility and comparability of LLM agents for data-science automation.
